headline: Core care works; release rehearsal remains
summary: Complete replay and the saved-state rehearsal before release.
release_boundary:
The first release requires the application runner, sign-in, shared-care recording and a saved-state rollback rehearsal. Offline capture remains in the full goal and is deferred from this release.

Whole-slice acceptance, merging and deployment remain visible in each checklist. Release approval also requires the completed rehearsal and an agreed operating plan.
limitations:
This is a fictional format example, not a live MedTracker status report. Evidence URLs are placeholders. The retained MedTracker HTML supplies the design reference only.

The first-release column counts its explicitly required items. It does not declare the release approved or deployed. Full-goal deferrals remain in the slice denominators.

slices.title: Application foundation
slices.acceptance_criteria: Run the replacement through its normal entry point and record independent acceptance of the published runner.

items.title: Start the replacement application
items.works: The normal entry point starts the replacement and serves its pages.

slices.title: Sign-in and shared care
slices.acceptance_criteria: Accept all sign-in and care journeys, including withdrawn access, repeated requests and offline replay for the full goal.

items.title: Sign users in
items.works: Users can sign in, recover access and end a session.
items.next_action: Include the published account journeys in the final care review.

items.title: Record shared care activity
items.works: Current members can record care activity; withdrawn members are denied.
items.remaining: The hosted run for the published revision has not finished.
items.next_action: Inspect the hosted result for example-care-02 and resolve any failures.

items.title: Capture care activity while offline
items.works: A local draft stores activity while disconnected.
items.remaining: Replay, conflict handling and withdrawn-access checks remain.
items.next_action: Complete replay through the same authorised care operation.

slices.title: Release and rollback
slices.acceptance_criteria: Restore independent saved data, run the existing application and record the complete release rehearsal.

items.title: Rehearse restoration of saved data
items.remaining: Restoration and operation on the saved state are unproved.
items.next_action: Restore the agreed snapshot in an isolated environment and record the result.

foundation.title: Runner publication and acceptance
foundation.note: Illustrative evidence for implementation, local and hosted checks, publication, acceptance and merging. No deployment is recorded.

accounts.title: Published account journeys
accounts.note: Illustrative evidence for implemented journeys, passing local and hosted checks and publication. Whole-slice acceptance remains pending.

care.title: Published shared-care work with a pending hosted run
care.note: Illustrative evidence for implementation, passing local checks, publication and a pending hosted run. This item earns no point yet.

offline.title: Local offline draft
offline.note: Illustrative in-progress implementation; no complete replay checks or publication.

rehearsal-scope.title: Agreed restore rehearsal scope
rehearsal-scope.note: Hosted checks do not apply to this manually observed restore rehearsal. A published rehearsal record and passing local checks are still required.
